bottleneck: RE-FRAMED 2026-10-15 20:07 (Day-15 weekly review). The 10/11 "unproven reply rate" frame is now resolved into TWO structural gates that the week of data exposed: (1) SUPPLY — the price_plus_reply selection rule (¥10-15k objective-done + EARLY ≤3rd-5th applicant + free sample) rejects all ~86 daily post-filter CrowdWorks candidates (15 straight 0-GO scans 10/01-10/15; today 1,679→811→328→86→0 GO). Observed 0.84 proposals/day vs 46.7/day needed (base). The ≤10/0 kill windows for BOTH boards (CW 10/11-10/15 closed at 4/0; Coconala 5/0) were never reachable because volume never reached 10 — this is UNDER-VOLUME, not a demand verdict. (2) COLD-START — as a 0-review seller against 60-118 applicants/request, proposal→reply is 0/9. Calculator (g2_pipeline.mjs) still ranks price_plus_reply #1 (base P(G2) 0.442 / pess 0.143) BUT only on cap volume (24 proposals by 10/20), which supply starves; gap.achievable_at_current_rate=false, 131 proposals short. L5 check: org (mac-local daily scans) is ADEQUATE — the gate is the selection rule + cold-start positioning, not operators/cadence/tooling. Art.5.2 escalation (two reviews 10/08+10/15, 0 improvement, last change L1): the next H1 change is ≥L2 → sales-motion repositioned to a FIRST-WIN / first-review motion (see H1.selection_rule). Falsification checkpoint 10/18: combined ≥10 proposals & 0 replies → demand-falsified → L4; still <10 even widened → supply-falsified → L4. Passive listings (Coconala gig 4426150, BOOTH, Gumroad, Etsy, Stripe, Zenn, note) all 0 signals in 15 days — no new listing (Art.5.5 forbids copying the offer again). X stopped as sales (median imp 10<20, pc 1, 0 inquiries), keep daily numbers post. owner_queue empty.

hypotheses.selection_rule: REWRITTEN 2026-10-15 20:07 (Day-15 review, L2 escalation, lever still price_plus_reply = calculator #1 base P(G2) 0.442/pess 0.143). FIRST-WIN / first-review motion: the ≤3rd-5th EARLY-APPLICANT sub-filter is DROPPED — it was the component starving volume to 0 GO/day despite ~86 post-filter candidates/day. New rule: among the widened GO lane, SELECT the SMALLEST, fastest, objective-done jobs (clear done-condition, deliverable with existing capability/assets) at a competitive-but-PG-profitable price (¥5,000-10,000; PG-1/PG-2 condition 2 "profitable after fees" MUST still hold — never free/loss-leader) and lead the proposal with a free dummy-data sample + explicit done-definition. Goal: win the FIRST order→first review to break the 0-review cold-start that unlocks the rest of October, rather than only chasing one ¥10-15k order by 10/20. Target ≥3-5/day combined (off zero). Still ≤5/day combined, honest AI-assisted disclosure, no over-promise.
